_doc: HAIRLINE recorded SFX: sources (downloaded by scripts/assets/sfx.sh into .cache/sfx/dl/<source>/) and recipes (built by scripts/sfx/build.py into public/assets/sfx/<name>.ogg). Times are seconds in the source file. Categories set the loudness target and the Opus bitrate (see 'categories'). Every recipe also carries its catalogue fields (what, ch, replaces, bus) for docs/assets/sfx.md.

recipes.name: hammer_floor
recipes.what: Odile's hammer blow heard through the floor: muffled wood knock with a low body thump and a short dark room tail
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat: hammering from downstairs (3-blow bursts, last burst through the fade)
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.8 (+-1.5 dB per blow); irregular 3-blow bursts (see Integration); lowpass 850 Hz at runtime (near-transparent, the files are pre-filtered), no extra room (the small-room tail is baked); random variant per blow, never the same twice, +-4% playbackRate; pair with the cam.shake
